summary: Ansible 12 (ansible-core 2.19) breaking changes: the toml library is dropped for TOML inventory (use tomli or tomli-w), assert quiet must be a real boolean, non-boolean conditional results are an error unless ALLOW_BROKEN_CONDITIONALS is enabled, first_found drops undefined list items with a warning, AnsibleLoader/AnsibleDumper are factory functions, native_jinja is removed, and lookups always get terms positionally.
questions: Why do my conditionals fail with a non-boolean result error?
Which library does the TOML inventory need now?
Why does first_found warn about undefined values?

answer_card.title: Conditionals must return booleans (ansible-core 2.19)
answer_card.answer_md: A `when:` or other conditional whose result is not a boolean is now an error. This usually means a template is used where it is not supported, which made the condition always true. Fix the expression so it returns `true` or `false`. To get a deprecation warning instead of an error for now, enable the `ALLOW_BROKEN_CONDITIONALS` config option.
